body.title: Blanket .cursor/ gitignore blocks tracked scout hook commits
body.summary: Repos with .cursor/ in gitignore need negation rules for hooks.json and hooks/** before scout hook PR can land.
body.canonicalQuestion: Why did git add reject .cursor/hooks.json on Scraper?
